external_sources.adaptation: Offline HSV masks and connectedComponentsWithStats in manually recorded bounded symbol regions; bounding boxes propose visible wireframe centers. Each source image and candidate was visually reviewed.

decision: Use the existing mature OpenCV implementation for offline source annotation, preserving Python/Qt and existing source-qualified map reader and native marker interactions. No battle-camera projection port; no upstream application code copied.
